references.text: Tappuah is mentioned as one of the cities whose king was defeated by Joshua, which shows the historical context for Bet-Tappuah as a city in the hill country of Judah.
Tappuah is mentioned again in connection with the border between Manasseh and Ephraim, showing that the name Tappuah was used for several places in Canaan.
Aphek is mentioned as one of the Canaanite cities whose king was defeated, and Aphekah in this verse may be related to the same place-name tradition.
Aphek is mentioned as the place where the Philistines gathered to fight against Israel, showing the strategic importance of cities with this name.
